item.proficiency.duelists_rapier.desc: Light and fast. Every third hit on one target lands 50% harder.

proficiency.proc.swords.desc: A sword hit deals double damage. More with proc power.
proficiency.proc.swords.short: Double damage on a sword hit.
proficiency.skill.axes.desc: Damage when an axe is used as a weapon.
proficiency.proc.axes.desc: An axe hit deals 1.6x damage and half of it splashes on mobs within 3 blocks. More with proc power.
proficiency.proc.axes.short: A heavy hit that splashes nearby mobs.
proficiency.proc.maces.desc: A mace hit deals 1.6x damage; 40% of it splashes on mobs within 3 blocks and knocks them back. More with proc power.
proficiency.proc.maces.short: A heavy hit that shakes nearby mobs.
proficiency.skill.tridents.desc: Damage with tridents, thrown or in hand.
proficiency.proc.tridents.desc: A trident hit, thrown or in melee, deals double damage. More with proc power.
proficiency.proc.tridents.short: Double damage on a trident hit.
proficiency.proc.unarmed.desc: A punch deals double damage, knocks the target back and slows it for 3 seconds. Longer and harder with proc power.
proficiency.proc.unarmed.short: A punch that hits twice as hard and slows.
proficiency.skill.blocking.desc: Less shield wear and less knockback while blocking.
proficiency.proc.blocking.desc: Blocking a hit with a shield costs no shield durability and returns 75% of the blocked damage to the attacker. More with proc power.
proficiency.proc.blocking.short: A block that costs nothing and hits back.
proficiency.skill.endurance.desc: More maximum health. Trained by losing health to anything and living through it.
proficiency.proc.endurance.desc: A hit that leaves you under 30% health heals you 4 health (2 hearts). More with proc power.
proficiency.proc.archery.desc: An arrow hit deals double damage. More with proc power.
proficiency.proc.archery.short: Double damage on an arrow hit.
proficiency.proc.crossbows.desc: A bolt hit deals double damage. More with proc power.
proficiency.proc.crossbows.short: Double damage on a bolt hit.
proficiency.skill.mining.desc: Faster with a pickaxe, further reach into the rock, and sometimes a second drop. Blocks you placed pay no XP when broken.
proficiency.proc.mining.desc: Breaking a block with a pickaxe drops 2 extra copies of its drops. More with proc power.
proficiency.skill.woodcutting.desc: Faster through wood, and sometimes a second drop. Blocks you placed pay no XP when broken.
proficiency.proc.woodcutting.desc: Chopping a log fells the whole connected tree, up to 128 logs. Bigger with proc power.
proficiency.proc.woodcutting.short: Fells the whole tree at once.
proficiency.skill.excavation.desc: Faster with a shovel, and sometimes a second drop. Blocks you placed pay no XP when broken.
proficiency.proc.excavation.desc: Digging a block with a shovel also digs the 3x3 square around it and gives 2 extra copies of its drops. More with proc power.
proficiency.proc.excavation.short: Digs a 3x3 patch and drops extra.
proficiency.skill.farming.desc: Chance of a second harvest from a grown crop. Blocks you placed pay no XP when broken.
proficiency.proc.farming.desc: Harvesting a crop drops 2 extra copies and replants it. More with proc power.
proficiency.proc.farming.short: A harvest drops extra and replants.
proficiency.skill.fishing.desc: Less wear on the rod, and sometimes a second catch.
proficiency.proc.fishing.desc: Catching something also hauls up one random treasure. More treasure rolls with proc power.
proficiency.proc.fishing.short: A catch also hauls up treasure.
proficiency.proc.running.desc: Sprinting far enough grants Speed II for 6 seconds. Longer with proc power.
proficiency.proc.running.short: A long sprint grants a burst of speed.
proficiency.proc.sneaking.desc: Sneaking far enough makes you invisible for 4 seconds. Longer with proc power.
proficiency.proc.jumping.desc: A fall that would hurt (over 3.5 blocks) deals no damage at all.
proficiency.skill.swimming.desc: Faster in water, and breath lasts longer.
proficiency.proc.swimming.desc: Swimming far enough grants Dolphin's Grace for 6 seconds. Longer with proc power.
proficiency.skill.smithing.desc: Cheaper anvil work and sturdier repairs.
proficiency.proc.smithing.desc: Crafting a tool, weapon or armor piece makes another copy and drops a Masterwork Ingot. More copies with proc power.
proficiency.proc.smithing.short: A crafted piece is made twice, plus an ingot.
proficiency.skill.cooking.desc: Chance of a second helping out of the furnace.
proficiency.proc.cooking.desc: Cooking or crafting food gives 2 extra portions. More with proc power.
proficiency.proc.alchemy.desc: Drinking a potion returns the potion and gives a Prospector's Draught. Two potions with proc power.
proficiency.proc.alchemy.short: A drunk potion comes back, plus a bonus draught.
proficiency.skill.spellcasting.desc: Damage from spells. Needs Ars Nouveau to have anything to measure.
proficiency.proc.spellcasting.desc: An arcane spell hit deals double damage. More with proc power.
proficiency.proc.spellcasting.short: A spell hit deals double damage.
proficiency.skill.engineering.desc: Building machines. Counts Create, AE2 and the storage mods.
proficiency.proc.engineering.desc: Placing a machine or crafting machine parts gives one free copy. Two with proc power.
proficiency.proc.engineering.short: A machine or part comes with a free copy.
proficiency.skill.beastslaying.desc: Damage against everything the pack added, and more for the big ones.
proficiency.proc.beastslaying.desc: Killing a modded creature drops a Hunter's Charm. Two with proc power. Bosses always drop one.
proficiency.proc.beastslaying.short: A modded creature drops a Hunter's Charm.
proficiency.skill.wayfaring.desc: Standing somewhere you have never stood. Faster while the ground is new.
proficiency.proc.wayfaring.desc: Discovering a new biome gives a Wanderer's Token. Two with proc power.
proficiency.proc.wayfaring.short: A new biome gives a Wanderer's Token.
proficiency.skill.spelunking.desc: Ore taken from deep down. The deeper it was, the more it counts.
proficiency.proc.spelunking.desc: Mining an ore gives Night Vision for 60 seconds and makes ores within 8 blocks sparkle. Longer and farther with proc power.
proficiency.proc.spelunking.short: Mining ore gives Night Vision and ore glints.
proficiency.skill.masonry.desc: Placing full building blocks; stairs, slabs and walls count half. Further placement reach, and blocks you get back.
proficiency.proc.masonry.desc: Placing a block gives 3 blocks back. More with proc power.
proficiency.skill.decorating.desc: Placing fences, doors, panes, glass, lanterns, furniture and paintings; stairs, slabs and walls count half. Blocks you get back.
proficiency.proc.decorating.desc: Placing a decoration gives 3 blocks back. More with proc power.
proficiency.skill.social.desc: A bigger company bonus. Trained only by the extra XP company adds, so work next to other players.
proficiency.proc.social.desc: You and every player in your company radius earn 20% more XP for 15 seconds. More with proc power. Rolls at most once a minute of shared work.
proficiency.proc.social.short: You and your company earn more XP for a while.
proficiency.social.good_company: Good company from %s: more XP for 15 seconds
proficiency.skill.nightwalker.desc: Dark Sight: in the dark you see a little of Night Vision's light. Trained by any work you do in the dark and by time out at night. A light in either hand or worn on the belt switches it off.
proficiency.proc.nightwalker.desc: Killing a hostile mob while you stand in the dark gives Night Vision and Speed for 10 seconds. Longer with proc power.
proficiency.proc.nightwalker.short: A kill in the dark gives Night Vision and Speed.
proficiency.skill.courage.desc: More damage for every mob after you beyond the first. Trained by the damage you deal and the kills you make when the odds are against you: outnumbered, or facing a stronger foe or a boss. Low health and light armour make those fights pay more. Even odds pay nothing.
proficiency.proc.courage.desc: A kill while two or more mobs are after you gives Strength I for 10 seconds and a short burst of Speed. Longer with proc power.
proficiency.proc.courage.short: A kill while outnumbered gives Strength and Speed.
proficiency.skill.guardian.desc: The players around you take less damage. Trained only by protecting another player: taking hits from mobs that were after them, blocking or absorbing hits next to them, killing a mob that just hurt them, healing them with thrown potions, and staying at their side when they nearly die. The closer they are to death, the more it pays. Nothing with no player near.
proficiency.proc.guardian.desc: When a mob hits a player within 6 blocks of you, you sometimes take the hit instead, at half damage. More proc power, less damage.
proficiency.proc.guardian.short: Sometimes you take a friend's hit at half damage.
proficiency.skill.charger.desc: First in, always moving forward. First blood hits harder. Trained by first blood (the first hit on a fresh mob that no player hit in the last 10 seconds, once per mob), by charge hits (close 5 blocks on the target in 2 seconds, any way you like; a sprint attack pays more), and by kills in Spearhead: a friend behind you and mobs ahead. Melee only.
proficiency.proc.charger.desc: A charge hit sometimes pushes back and staggers (Slowness II) the hostile mobs in a small cone in front of you. A sprint attack makes it more likely. More proc power, a harder push and a longer stagger.
proficiency.proc.charger.short: A charge hit staggers the mobs ahead of you.
proficiency.skill.tactician.desc: The back line: fight with range from behind your friends, and make the front line stronger. More ranged damage on a mob that is after someone else. Trained by ranged hits on mobs that are after another player, by ranged kills of mobs that just hurt one, and by shots with a friend between you and the mob (Overwatch). Any ranged weapon: a bow, a crossbow, a thrown trident, a spell, a potion. A mob after nobody, or only after you, pays nothing.
proficiency.proc.tactician.desc: A ranged hit sometimes marks the mob for 8 seconds: it glows red for everyone, a crosshair floats over its head for every player within 48 blocks, and your friends (not you) deal 15% more damage to it. More proc power, a bigger bonus.
proficiency.proc.tactician.short: A ranged hit can mark a mob for your friends.
proficiency.skill.homebuilder.desc: Keeping a home. By a lit Hearth you move faster and reach further, and with Tidy Home loose items fly to you. Trained by anything you do at home, and by the home's milestones: a stage sealed, a new Comfort kind or Character block you placed, a siege defended, a Feast, Tales told, a Chronicle page.
proficiency.proc.homebuilder.desc: A gain you earn at home that charged the Hearth charges it again, into the same pool and within its hourly cap. It rolls at most once every 10 seconds. More proc power, a bigger second charge.
proficiency.proc.homebuilder.short: A gain at home charges the Hearth twice.
proficiency.skill.husbandry.desc: Looking after animals. Breed them, tame them, shear, milk and brush them, take honey and feed babies so they grow up. The babies you breed grow up faster and your pets are hardier. A crowded pen pays less, so spread your work around.
proficiency.proc.husbandry.desc: Breeding two animals sometimes gives a second baby. With Big Litter it can be a third.
proficiency.skill.riding.desc: Metres on a mount, in a boat, in a minecart or under elytra. Horses, donkeys, camels, pigs, striders and modded mounts pay by the metre, and a glide pays more for skimming the ground fast. You have to steer: a ride dragged by a leash or left to drift pays nothing, and neither does riding the same ground again within 10 minutes. The mounts you ride run faster and jump higher, and your elytra wears slower.
proficiency.proc.riding.desc: Riding sometimes gives you a tailwind. A mount gets Speed and Jump Boost, elytra push you forward, and in a boat or a minecart the ride refreshes you.
proficiency.proc.riding.short: A burst of speed from the saddle.
proficiency.skill.commerce.desc: Trading with villagers, wandering traders, modded traders and piglins. A trade pays by the emeralds in the offer and the trader's level, more for each new profession and each new item you buy, and less for the same offer again within a day. Gold ingots you give a piglin pay too. Traders ask less of you as you learn, and a good deal sometimes gives part of your payment back.
proficiency.proc.commerce.desc: A trade sometimes costs you only half: part of what you paid is handed straight back.
proficiency.proc.commerce.short: Part of a trade's price comes back.

proficiency.synergy.prospectors_forge.de: Auto-smelted ore trains Smithing, and one smelt in four gives an extra ingot.
proficiency.synergy.prospectors_forge.sh: Smelted ore trains Smithing and can double.
proficiency.synergy.woodsmans_edge.desc: Every log Timber fells trains Axes.
proficiency.synergy.deep_delver.desc: Below Y 0, Motherlode fires half again as often.
proficiency.synergy.deep_delver.short: Motherlode fires more often below Y 0.
proficiency.synergy.silent_hunter.desc: Ambush: every hit you land from a crouch deals 30% more.
proficiency.synergy.silent_hunter.short: Hits from a crouch deal more.
proficiency.synergy.juggernaut.desc: A hit caught on your shield charges your next mace or axe swing within 5 seconds for 50% more.
proficiency.synergy.juggernaut.short: A blocked hit charges your next swing.
proficiency.synergy.stalwart.desc: What gets past the shield toughens the one holding it.
proficiency.synergy.stalwart.short: What gets past your shield toughens you.
proficiency.synergy.tidecaller.desc: In water or rain, Tridents and Fishing signatures fire twice as often.
proficiency.synergy.tidecaller.short: Water and rain make two procs fire more.
proficiency.synergy.apothecary.desc: Kitchen and brewing stand share a shelf.
proficiency.synergy.arcane_engineering.d: Spells and machines teach each other.
proficiency.synergy.siege_engineer.desc: A crossbow is a machine too.
proficiency.synergy.bowyer.desc: You know the wood your bow is made of.
proficiency.synergy.monster_hunter.desc: A sword that has met the pack's worst things cuts deeper.
proficiency.synergy.monster_hunter.short: Swords cut deeper into the pack's worst.
proficiency.synergy.pathfinder.desc: Legs and a sense of direction, together.
proficiency.synergy.earthshaper.desc: What you dig out, you know how to build with.
proficiency.synergy.master_builder.desc: The castle and the rooms inside it, by one hand.
proficiency.synergy.master_builder.short: Masonry and Decorating work as one.
proficiency.synergy.caravan.desc: The road trains the company, and the company finds more road.
proficiency.synergy.caravan.short: Travel trains company, company finds roads.
proficiency.synergy.night_hunter.desc: A kill from a crouch in the dark is always a Moonlit.
proficiency.synergy.night_hunter.short: A crouched kill in the dark is a Moonlit.
proficiency.synergy.fearless_heart.desc: The hit you take becomes the hit you give back: a Grit also gives Strength I for 5 seconds.
proficiency.synergy.bulwark.desc: An Intercept while your shield is up lands on the shield, not on you.
proficiency.synergy.bulwark.short: An Intercept lands on your shield.
proficiency.synergy.oathkeeper.desc: Killing a mob that just hurt another player always gives you Rally.
proficiency.synergy.oathkeeper.short: Avenging a player always gives Rally.
proficiency.synergy.shield_and_spear.des: A Guardian behind a Charger in Spearhead already makes Spearhead hit harder (x1.5) and hold firm. With this synergy on either of the two, it is x2.
proficiency.synergy.shield_and_spear.sho: Guardian behind Charger makes Spearhead stronger.
proficiency.synergy.hammer_and_anvil.des: A Charger's first blood on a mob a Tactician marked already hits x1.5 harder, and a Tactician's hits on a mob fighting a Charger pay double XP. With this synergy on either of the two, the first blood is x2.
proficiency.synergy.hammer_and_anvil.sho: Charger and Tactician set up each other.
proficiency.synergy.covering_fire.desc: A Tactician's ranged hit on a mob that is after a Guardian already makes it hit players 25% softer for 3 seconds. With this synergy on either of the two, 40% for 6 seconds.
proficiency.synergy.covering_fire.short: Tactician hits make mobs hit players softer.
proficiency.synergy.heart_of_home.desc: A Feast at a Hearth counts as a House Proud for everyone at it: they share your home passive for 30 seconds, and no cooldown is used.
proficiency.synergy.heart_of_home.short: A Feast shares your home passive with everyone.
proficiency.synergy.renaissance.desc: Grandmaster of three trees: every skill learns faster and works better.
proficiency.synergy.renaissance.short: Three grandmaster trees boost every skill.

proficiency.talent.swords.swordplay.desc: Where the tree starts. Fill it to open the branches, the signature move and the ability.
proficiency.talent.swords.keen_edge.desc: A sharper blade in a surer hand.
proficiency.talent.swords.parry.desc: Holding a sword, 5% chance per rank to turn aside a melee hit completely.
proficiency.talent.swords.parry.short: Sometimes turns a hit aside completely.
proficiency.talent.swords.lunge.desc: A sprinting sword hit is a critical hit. Ready again after 9 seconds, 3 seconds sooner per rank.
proficiency.talent.swords.lunge.short: Sprinting hits can land as critical hits.
proficiency.talent.swords.hemorrhage.des: Perfect Strike makes the target bleed (Wither) for 2 seconds per rank.
proficiency.talent.swords.hemorrhage.sho: Perfect Strike makes the target bleed.
proficiency.talent.swords.executioner.de: +10% damage per rank to targets under 30% health.
Perfect Strike heals you 1 health per rank.
proficiency.talent.swords.duelist.desc: +30% damage while only one hostile is within 8 blocks.
proficiency.talent.swords.duelist.short: Hit harder when you fight one foe alone.
proficiency.talent.swords.sword_saint.de: A Perfect Strike makes your next sword hit within 3 seconds a Perfect Strike too.
proficiency.talent.swords.sword_saint.sh: A Perfect Strike can chain into the next.
proficiency.talent.axes.hewing.desc: Where the tree starts. Fill it to open the branches, the signature move and the ability.
proficiency.talent.axes.cleaving_arc.des: Cleave reaches 1 block further per rank.
proficiency.talent.axes.rend.desc: A critical axe hit opens a wound: for 4 seconds the target takes 15% more damage from weapon hits.
proficiency.talent.axes.rend.short: Critical hits leave a wound that takes more damage.
proficiency.talent.axes.berserker.desc: +3% damage per rank for every 10% of health you are missing.
proficiency.talent.axes.berserker.short: The more hurt you are, the harder you hit.
proficiency.talent.axes.sunder.desc: Everything Cleave hits is Weakened for 2 seconds per rank.
proficiency.talent.axes.bloodrush.desc: An axe kill gives Speed and Strength for 2 seconds per rank.
proficiency.talent.axes.bloodrush.short: An axe kill makes you faster and stronger.
proficiency.talent.axes.rampage.desc: Longer Berserk, and a streak that pays more.
proficiency.talent.axes.undying_rage.des: Once every 5 minutes, a killing blow leaves you at 1 health while you hold an axe.
proficiency.talent.axes.undying_rage.sho: Now and then, a killing blow leaves you at 1.
proficiency.talent.axes.warlord.desc: Every axe kill heals you 2 health.
proficiency.talent.maces.heft.desc: Where the tree starts. Fill it to open the branches, the signature move and the ability.
proficiency.talent.maces.meteor.desc: +4% damage per rank for every block you fell before the hit, up to 20 blocks.
proficiency.talent.maces.meteor.short: The longer you fall, the harder you hit.
proficiency.talent.maces.aftershock.desc: Shockwave reaches 1 block further per rank.
proficiency.talent.maces.concussion.desc: Shockwave's main target is slowed to a crawl for 1 second per rank.
proficiency.talent.maces.concussion.shor: The main target of Shockwave is slowed.
proficiency.talent.maces.wind_rider.desc: For 3 seconds after a mace hit you take no fall damage.
proficiency.talent.maces.wind_rider.shor: No fall damage right after a mace hit.
proficiency.talent.maces.cratermaker.des: A hit after falling 6 blocks or more is always a Shockwave.
proficiency.talent.maces.cratermaker.sho: A hit after a big fall is a Shockwave.
proficiency.talent.maces.titan.desc: Shockwave throws everything it hits into the air.
proficiency.talent.maces.titan.short: Shockwave throws foes into the air.
proficiency.talent.tridents.spearcraft.d: Where the tree starts. Fill it to open the branches, the signature move and the ability.
proficiency.talent.tridents.tidal_edge.d: +6% trident damage per rank while you stand in water or rain.
proficiency.talent.tridents.tidal_edge.s: Hit harder in water or rain.
proficiency.talent.tridents.undertow.des: A trident proc drags the target toward you, harder per rank.
proficiency.talent.tridents.undertow.sho: A proc drags the target toward you.
Holding a trident, you breathe underwater.
proficiency.talent.tridents.impaler.desc: The signature strike comes more often.
proficiency.talent.tridents.conductor.de: A trident proc in a thunderstorm calls lightning down on the target.
proficiency.talent.tridents.conductor.sh: A proc in a thunderstorm calls lightning.
proficiency.talent.tridents.sea_king.des: Holding a trident in water gives you Conduit Power.
proficiency.talent.tridents.sea_king.sho: A trident in water gives Conduit Power.
proficiency.talent.unarmed.knuckles.desc: Where the tree starts. Fill it to open the branches, the signature move and the ability.
proficiency.talent.unarmed.haymaker.desc: The knockout blow comes more often.
proficiency.talent.unarmed.combo.desc: Each punch within 1.5 seconds of the last adds 5% per rank, up to 5 stacks.
proficiency.talent.unarmed.combo.short: Quick punches in a row hit harder.
proficiency.talent.unarmed.stagger.desc: The knockout blow Weakens the target for 2 seconds per rank.
proficiency.talent.unarmed.stagger.short: The knockout blow leaves the target weakened.
proficiency.talent.unarmed.iron_skin.des: With an empty main hand you take 5% less damage per rank.
proficiency.talent.unarmed.iron_skin.sho: Take less damage with an empty hand.
proficiency.talent.unarmed.fury.desc: A longer ability and a streak that pays more.
proficiency.talent.unarmed.flow.desc: A critical punch gives Speed and Haste for 1 second per rank.
proficiency.talent.unarmed.flow.short: Critical punches give a burst of speed.
proficiency.talent.unarmed.one_inch_punc: The knockout blow sends its target flying three times as far.
The knockout blow sends foes flying.
Every bare-handed hit heals you half a heart.
proficiency.talent.blocking.guard.desc: Where the tree starts. Fill it to open the branches, the signature move and the ability.
proficiency.talent.blocking.reinforced.d: The shield wears slower and you stand firmer.
proficiency.talent.blocking.tenacity.des: Dying keeps more of this skill's progress.
Blocking a melee hit shoves the attacker back, harder per rank.
proficiency.talent.blocking.bastion.desc: While you block, players within 4 blocks take 5% less damage per rank.
proficiency.talent.blocking.bastion.shor: Blocking shields the players near you.
proficiency.talent.blocking.spiked_rim.d: Every blocked hit deals 1 damage per rank back to the attacker.
proficiency.talent.blocking.aegis.desc: Every blocked hit gives you a heart of absorption, up to four.
proficiency.talent.blocking.aegis.short: Blocked hits give you absorption hearts.
proficiency.talent.blocking.immovable.de: Holding your shield up, nothing can knock you back. This skill never loses progress to death.
proficiency.talent.blocking.immovable.sh: No knockback while blocking. Death keeps it.

Moonlit adds Strength and can renew itself.

proficiency.talent.courage.hot_blood.des: The more of them after you, the harder you hit.
proficiency.talent.courage.hot_blood.sho: The more foes, the harder you hit.
proficiency.talent.courage.hold_the_line: With 3 or more mobs after you, you take 5% less damage from mobs per rank.
Take less damage from a crowd of mobs.
+8% damage per rank to bosses and to mobs with 40 or more max health.
Hit bosses and big mobs harder.
proficiency.talent.courage.unshaken.desc: Slowness and Weakness from mobs are a third shorter per rank. At rank 3 they never land.
proficiency.talent.courage.unshaken.shor: Slowness and Weakness from mobs fade sooner.
proficiency.talent.courage.spoils_of_val: Killing a boss or a mob stronger than you heals 2 health per rank.
Killing a strong foe heals you.
proficiency.talent.courage.challenge.des: Hit a mob that is after another player within 4 blocks of you per rank, and it turns on you.
proficiency.talent.courage.challenge.sho: Hit a mob and it turns on you.
Rally also gives its Strength and Speed to every player within 8 blocks.
Rally also boosts the players near you.
proficiency.talent.courage.lionheart.des: The passive reaches its full bonus with 3 mobs after you, not 5, and a kill while outnumbered takes 5 seconds off Stand Your Ground's cooldown.
proficiency.talent.guardian.vigil.desc: Where the tree starts. Fill it to open the branches, the signature move and the ability.
proficiency.talent.guardian.warding.desc: The players around you take a little less damage.
proficiency.talent.guardian.warding.shor: The players near you take less damage.
proficiency.talent.guardian.taunt.desc: Hit a mob and it turns on you. For 5 seconds it cannot switch to anyone else.
proficiency.talent.guardian.taunt.short: A hit mob stays on you for a while.
proficiency.talent.guardian.bodyguard.de: Intercept and Shield Wall reach 2 blocks further per rank.
proficiency.talent.guardian.bodyguard.sh: Intercept and Shield Wall reach further.
proficiency.talent.guardian.mending_guar: Each hit you block with a shield heals the most hurt player within 8 blocks by 1 health per rank.
Blocked hits heal the most hurt friend.
proficiency.talent.guardian.cover.desc: Intercept takes less of the hit.
proficiency.talent.guardian.heartshare.d: When you get Absorption, the most hurt player within 8 blocks gets it too, for a third of its time per rank.
proficiency.talent.guardian.heartshare.s: Your absorption is shared with a friend.
proficiency.talent.guardian.watchful_com: Your Friend Compass shows your friend's health, and pulses when they are hurt while it is in your hotbar.
Your Friend Compass shows their health.
proficiency.talent.guardian.sworn_shield: Once every 10 minutes, a blow that would kill a player within 8 blocks of you hits you instead, at half damage.
Now and then, take a killing blow for a friend.
proficiency.talent.guardian.sentinel.des: Shield Wall also gives Resistance I to every player in it, and each hit you take for another player takes 2 seconds off Shield Wall's cooldown.
proficiency.talent.guardian.sentinel.sho: Shield Wall protects and recharges faster.
proficiency.guardian.sworn: You took the blow meant for %s.
proficiency.guardian.sworn_saved: %s took the blow meant for you.
proficiency.talent.charger.momentum.desc: Where the tree starts. Fill it to open the branches, the signature move and the ability.
proficiency.talent.charger.first_in.desc: Your first blood on a mob hits harder.
proficiency.talent.charger.trust_the_lin: Only in Spearhead: damage from friends is cut by 50%, 65% and 80% at rank 1, 2 and 3, so stray arrows and sweeps from the back line do not kill you.
In Spearhead, friends hurt you far less.
proficiency.talent.charger.crash_in.desc: First blood's Absorption lasts 4 seconds longer per rank, and is Absorption II at rank 3.
proficiency.talent.charger.head_start.de: A charge needs half a block less per rank (5 blocks, down to 3.5).
proficiency.talent.charger.rolling_thund: Breach pushes harder and staggers longer.
proficiency.talent.charger.red_harvest.d: In the 5 seconds after a charge hit, your hits heal 5% more of their damage per rank.
proficiency.talent.charger.red_harvest.s: After a charge hit, your hits heal you.
proficiency.talent.charger.spearpoint.de: Spearhead counts friends up to 24 blocks behind you, and its damage bonus is 10% higher.
proficiency.talent.charger.spearpoint.sh: Spearhead reaches further and hits harder.
proficiency.talent.charger.onslaught.des: A kill within 3 seconds of your first blood makes your next hit on another mob a first blood too.
proficiency.talent.charger.onslaught.sho: A quick kill chains into another first blood.
proficiency.talent.charger.warbringer.de: Each first blood takes 3 seconds off Charge!'s cooldown, and Charge!'s dash goes twice as far.
proficiency.talent.charger.warbringer.sh: First blood speeds up Charge! and its dash.
proficiency.talent.tactician.vantage.des: Where the tree starts. Fill it to open the branches, the signature move and the ability.
proficiency.talent.tactician.spotter.des: More ranged damage on a mob that is after someone else.
proficiency.talent.tactician.spotter.sho: More ranged damage on mobs after a friend.
Your projectiles fly through other players, and nothing you shoot or throw hurts them.
Your shots pass through your friends.
proficiency.talent.tactician.headshot.de: A projectile that hits a mob in the head deals 10% more damage per rank.
proficiency.talent.tactician.crossfire.d: Each friend standing between you and the mob you hit (up to 3) adds 3% damage per rank.
proficiency.talent.tactician.crossfire.s: Friends in the line of fire add damage.
proficiency.talent.tactician.opening.des: Your Called Shot also makes a Charger's next hit on that mob count as first blood.
proficiency.talent.tactician.opening.sho: Your mark sets up a Charger's first blood.
proficiency.talent.tactician.quartermast: A ranged kill on a mob you marked gives the arrow back, a 1 in 3 chance per rank.
A kill on your mark can return the arrow.
proficiency.talent.tactician.painted_tar: Your mark lasts 4 seconds longer, and friends deal 5% more damage to it on top.
Your mark lasts longer and hurts more.
When a mob you marked dies, the mark jumps to the nearest hostile mob within 8 blocks.
When your mark dies, it jumps to the next foe.
proficiency.talent.tactician.field_marsh: Your mark lasts 4 seconds longer, each kill a friend makes on it takes 3 seconds off Suppressing Fire's cooldown, and Suppressing Fire slows one level harder.
Longer mark; kills on it speed your ability.
proficiency.talent.homebuilder.hearthkee: Where the tree starts. Fill it to open the branches, the signature move and the ability.
proficiency.talent.homebuilder.light_ste: At home you move, reach and pull a little further.
proficiency.talent.homebuilder.tidy_home: Rank 1 turns on the item magnet at home. Rank 2 also pulls experience orbs. Rank 3 pulls twice as fast.
Pulls items to you at home.
proficiency.talent.homebuilder.scaffolde: At home a fall has to be 3 blocks higher before it hurts you, 5 at rank 2 and 8 at rank 3. For building on the roof.
proficiency.talent.homebuilder.long_pull: The magnet reaches 1 block further per rank.
proficiency.talent.homebuilder.warm_welc: Your Warmth fills 10% faster per rank, on top of Homecoming's readiness.
proficiency.talent.homebuilder.storytell: You bank 10% more Tales per rank on your trips.
Bank more Tales on your trips.
proficiency.talent.homebuilder.open_hous: House Proud lasts longer, and friends up to 8 blocks per rank outside the Hearth's range share it too.
Longer House Proud that reaches further.
proficiency.talent.homebuilder.night_wat: Siege mobs in range glow for you, and you hear the siege horn an in-game hour early.
See siege mobs; hear sieges coming early.

Once a day, recall to your Hearth.
proficiency.talent.husbandry.stockman.de: Where the tree starts. Fill it to open the branches, the signature move and the ability.
Babies you breed grow up faster and your pets are hardier.
proficiency.talent.husbandry.gentle_hand: Mounting an untamed horse, donkey, mule or llama adds 6 temper per rank (of 100), so it settles after fewer rides.
proficiency.talent.husbandry.wool_gather: Shearing a sheep drops 1 more wool per rank.
proficiency.talent.husbandry.wolf_learns: Your tamed wolves learn from you: each rank adds a third of your best weapon skill's damage bonus to their bites.
Your wolves bite with your weapon skill.
When Twins lands there is a 10% chance per rank of a third baby.
Milking a cow or goat: 20% chance per rank that a second empty bucket in your inventory fills too.
Milking can fill a second bucket.
proficiency.talent.husbandry.shared_stre: Your tamed pets hit 10% harder per rank on a mob you hit in the last 5 seconds.
Pets hit harder on mobs you hit.
proficiency.talent.husbandry.faithful_fr: A pet of yours that would die inside a lit Hearth's range is saved instead, at a quarter of its health. Once per 10 minutes. It never does anything for you.
A pet at your Hearth is saved from death.
proficiency.talent.husbandry.herd_master: Babies you breed are born with half of their growing already done, and Pasture Blessing gives your pets Speed too.
proficiency.talent.riding.horsemanship.d: Where the tree starts. Fill it to open the branches, the signature move and the ability.
proficiency.talent.riding.good_seat.desc: Mounts you ride are faster and jump higher, and your elytra wears slower.
While mounted your melee hits deal 6% more damage per rank, and 6% more again while your mount is at a full gallop (7 blocks a second).
proficiency.talent.riding.barding.desc: A mount you ride takes 8% less damage per rank.
Arrows and bolts you loose from a mount hit 8% harder per rank.
proficiency.talent.riding.whistle.desc: Blowing a goat horn calls your nearest tamed horse, donkey or mule that nobody is riding or leading, from 64 blocks at rank 1, 96 at rank 2 and 128 at rank 3. Ready again after 100 seconds, 80 at rank 2 and 60 at rank 3.
proficiency.talent.riding.whistle.short: A goat horn calls your horse.
proficiency.talent.riding.high_seat.desc: While mounted your block and attack reach grows by half a block per rank.
proficiency.talent.riding.rocket_saver.d: A firework rocket you use in flight is not used up, a 15% chance per rank.
proficiency.talent.riding.rocket_saver.s: Rockets are sometimes not used up.
proficiency.talent.riding.soft_landing.d: After you leave a mount, a boat or a minecart you take no fall damage for 4 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
proficiency.talent.riding.soft_landing.s: No fall damage after you dismount.
proficiency.talent.riding.stampede.desc: A mount you ride at a full gallop tramples the hostile mobs it runs into: 3 damage, 1 more per 20 Riding levels, once a second per mob. Nobody earns XP for what it kills.
proficiency.talent.commerce.market_stall: Where the tree starts. Fill it to open the branches, the signature move and the ability.
proficiency.talent.commerce.fair_dealing: Traders ask less of you, and Hero's Welcome and Haggle build on it.
proficiency.talent.commerce.regulars.des: A villager you traded with restocks again 3 minutes after your last trade at rank 1, 2 minutes at rank 2 and 1 minute at rank 3, at most twice a day each. Never while someone is trading with it.
proficiency.talent.commerce.regulars.sho: Villagers you trade with restock sooner.
proficiency.talent.commerce.last_piece.d: A trade has a 10% chance per rank not to use up one of the offer's uses.
proficiency.talent.commerce.last_piece.s: A trade may not use up an offer's use.
proficiency.talent.commerce.gold_rush.de: A piglin you barter with has a 10% chance per rank to roll its loot a second time.
proficiency.talent.commerce.gold_rush.sh: Piglins sometimes roll their loot twice.
proficiency.talent.commerce.sweetener.de: A trade has an 8% chance per rank that the trader throws in something extra: a quarter more of a bulk buy, or a small gift with a single item.
proficiency.talent.commerce.sweetener.sh: A trader may throw in something extra.
proficiency.talent.commerce.old_debts.de: A villager you cured of zombification takes another 4% per rank off its prices, on top of what the cure already did.
proficiency.talent.commerce.old_debts.sh: Villagers you cured charge even less.
proficiency.talent.commerce.better_deals: A Good Deal gives back more of the price.
proficiency.talent.commerce.heros_welcom: While Hero of the Village is on you, the discount from this skill's passive is doubled.
Hero of the Village doubles your discount.
proficiency.talent.commerce.guild_master: Haggle takes 10 points more off every price.
Haggle takes more off every price.

proficiency.hearth.guide.title: Hearth guide
proficiency.hearth.guide.button.tip: How to build a Hearth stage by stage, what feeds its boons and what furniture counts.
proficiency.hearth.guide.status.away: Stand by your Hearth to see its stage, Comfort and Character here.
proficiency.hearth.guide.build.intro: Build around a lit campfire in one of eight designs. Each stage grows the one before it, up to 9x9x7. Pick a design and watch every stage turn. Right-click the Hearth with a stage's offering to seal it.
proficiency.hearth.guide.build.tip.any: The whole build, every block counted. Stone and wood can be any kind; metals are exact.
proficiency.hearth.guide.design.longhous: A stone pad with four log posts and a lantern on each.
A 5x5 stone floor, taller corner posts with lanterns and low fence rails.

A 7x7 open timber frame: log posts at the corners and beside each doorway, fence half-walls and a log wall plate. The fire stays in view. Eight stone-curbed water pools sit in the wall gaps beside the doors.
Stone steps around the hall and the first roof tier: a ring of wooden stairs for the eave, a second ring stepping up.
A second roof tier closes in toward the smoke hole, with a chain and lantern hung under each eave corner.
A third tier narrows the smoke hole to one block. Copper finials on the eave corners, banners at the doors, lodestone under the fire.
proficiency.hearth.guide.design.forge.1: A cross of stone with plank floor edges, and stone stubs topped with iron bars.
proficiency.hearth.guide.design.forge.2: A 5x5 stone floor with stone benches along the paths and a cauldron on four of them.
proficiency.hearth.guide.design.forge.3: A 7x7 stone shell with barred windows and stone arches over the doors, and a hollow two-course chimney hood over the fire. A quench pool of water fills each inner corner and an iron grate covers each empty outer corner.
proficiency.hearth.guide.design.forge.4: The outer corners fill with lava pits glowing at ground level through iron bars, with an anvil on a plinth in front of each. A slab roof with copper corner caps and the chimney's third course.
proficiency.hearth.guide.design.forge.5: A stone parapet on the roof, a fourth chimney course of iron bars and a cauldron beside each gate.
proficiency.hearth.guide.design.forge.6: A copper crown on the chimney top, a stone gate pylon opposite each cauldron, lodestone under the fire.
proficiency.hearth.guide.design.shrine.1: A stone pad with four fence posts and a lantern on each.
proficiency.hearth.guide.design.shrine.2: A 5x5 terrace, stone step rails and tall fence pillars capped with copper.
proficiency.hearth.guide.design.shrine.3: A ring of stone steps at 7x7 and a wooden roof floating on the pillars around an open oculus. Eight curbed water pools sit beside the doorways.
proficiency.hearth.guide.design.shrine.4: An outer ring of fence pillars with copper caps carries a wider second roof, with potted flowers on the rails.
proficiency.hearth.guide.design.shrine.5: A wider outer terrace and a raised roof tier that closes the oculus to the smoke hole, with a bell on a chain and a candle beside each doorway.
proficiency.hearth.guide.design.shrine.6: Gold and copper crown blocks, lightning rods at the corners, a low stone wall around the terrace, banners at the doors and lodestone under the fire.
Magma-block pillars with soul lanterns on a pad with crimson plank edges.
Blackstone benches with iron-bar rails and a plank boardwalk.
A 7x7 blackstone shell with barred, still-empty pits in the wall tops and a pool of water in each inner corner.
Roof slabs, tall corner spikes and eight lava pits in the wall tops, glowing behind iron bars.
A second roof ring, obsidian gate pillars with soul lanterns, and more soul lanterns hanging over the doorways.
A crimson crown ring, iron-bar spikes with skulls on the corner spikes, and lodestone under the fire.

proficiency.hearth.guide.design.gothic.4: A slab vault, corner spires and flying buttresses, with chains and lanterns hung over the fonts.
proficiency.hearth.guide.design.gothic.5: The spires rise to the top layer and a bell hangs over each doorway.
proficiency.hearth.guide.design.gothic.6: Gable spires with lightning rods above the doors, banners and lodestone under the fire.

proficiency.hearth.guide.design.girly.6: A top canopy tier with gold finials and banners at the doors.
proficiency.hearth.guide.design.ruin.1: A cracked-stone pad with dark log stubs topped by iron bars.
proficiency.hearth.guide.design.ruin.2: Broken stone stubs and benches, with a potted fern and moss on them.

proficiency.hearth.guide.design.frost.5: A second snow tier and a stone chimney around the smoke hole.

proficiency.hearth.guide.build.range: The Hearth reaches %s blocks around it, %s below and %s above. Skill XP you earn there feeds it; you keep all of yours.
proficiency.hearth.guide.build.spacing: No other Hearth may stand within %s blocks.
proficiency.hearth.guide.build.problem: Offer too early and the Hearth names the first thing missing, for example "stone wanted 2 north, 1 east, 1 up of the fire (23 blocks to go)".
proficiency.hearth.guide.build.layer: Break part of a stage and the Hearth drops back a stage. Its charge is held, and the offering is not owed again.
proficiency.hearth.guide.build.put_out: To put the Hearth out, sneak and hold attack for 3 seconds. It drops a plain campfire and loses its charge and offerings.
proficiency.hearth.guide.build.sieges: From stage III, when everyone is home and rested, the Hearth can draw a siege, announced a day ahead. Siege Horns call one on your schedule: five horns for siege levels I to V, each crafted from the one before and each needing a higher stage.
proficiency.hearth.guide.build.hover: Hover a stage for its full list of materials.
proficiency.hearth.guide.boons.intro: While you earn skill XP near the Hearth, %s%% of it is mirrored into five pools. You lose nothing. Each pool climbs tiers I to VI, and its tier sets its boon.
proficiency.hearth.guide.boons.warmth.bo: Stand by the Hearth for %s seconds, or sleep in a bed in range, to warm up fully. Boons on you scale with your Warmth, and it fades once you leave.
proficiency.hearth.guide.boons.cap: A pool takes at most %s charge per hour, so the top tiers take days of living there.
proficiency.hearth.guide.boons.ceiling: No pool rises above the stage you have built.
proficiency.hearth.guide.boons.decay: Charge fades slowly while nobody is home.
proficiency.hearth.guide.comfort.intro: Comfort counts the different kinds of furniture under a roof in range, each kind once. A lawn full of furniture scores nothing; a furnished house scores all of it.

proficiency.synergy.spellforged.desc: The smith's eye and the caster's touch: Whetstone and Temper gifts come half again as often, and can land at II or III. Each step up is its own roll, 25% to 50% with Spellcasting.
proficiency.synergy.spellforged.short: Whetstone and Temper gifts: more often, up to level III.
proficiency.synergy.guild_prices.desc: A good word at the anvil is worth a few levels.
proficiency.synergy.wrought_iron.desc: The gate you forged is the finest thing in the room.
proficiency.synergy.potluck.desc: Everyone brings a dish, and you bring two.
proficiency.synergy.sunday_roast.desc: Food eaten at home restores 2 more hunger and 2 more saturation.
proficiency.synergy.trail_rations.desc: Food that keeps, for roads that do not end.
proficiency.synergy.mana_tonic.desc: A brewer knows what the well is made of.
proficiency.synergy.field_medic.desc: A healing splash you throw also cures one harmful effect on each friend hit.
proficiency.synergy.starward.desc: Wards drawn by starlight hold through the night.
proficiency.synergy.ley_hall.desc: Lamps placed along the ley lines burn with more than fire.
proficiency.synergy.arcane_circle.desc: Spells learned together are cast in rhythm.
proficiency.synergy.battlemage.desc: The bigger the foe, the louder the echo.
proficiency.synergy.hexbane.desc: The undead fear the word as much as the blade.
proficiency.synergy.clockwork_home.desc: A house that does its own chores.
proficiency.synergy.bounty_road.desc: Every road has a beast on it, and a reward.
proficiency.synergy.witching_hour.desc: The night's worst things are the best trophies.

proficiency.synergy.glowworm_grotto.desc: A cave lit with care is a room worth keeping.
proficiency.synergy.shoring.desc: You prop up the roof before you trust it.
proficiency.synergy.root_cellar.desc: Every good home has a cave under it.
proficiency.synergy.hearthstone.desc: You laid the stone the fire sits on.
proficiency.synergy.housewarming.desc: A cozy room at home also feeds you: 1 hunger every 30 s.
proficiency.synergy.farm_to_table.desc: Crops and livestock, one kitchen garden.
proficiency.synergy.feed_the_herd.desc: Spare seed and a gentle hand keep the herd calm.
proficiency.synergy.packmaster.desc: Hunting with a wolf at your side teaches you both.
proficiency.synergy.fresh_dairy.desc: Milk straight from the pail makes better cooking.
proficiency.synergy.stable_roof.desc: A home with a good barn breeds more twins.
proficiency.synergy.village_herd.desc: Friends share the chores and the luck.
proficiency.synergy.watchdog.desc: A guardian and a loyal dog watch the same door.
proficiency.synergy.trail_companion.desc: A calm horse makes a long road shorter.
proficiency.synergy.brave_hounds.desc: A pack that has seen a fight does not flinch.
proficiency.synergy.honey_tonic.desc: Honey in the brew, summer in the pasture.
proficiency.synergy.open_country.desc: Long legs on the ground, a fair wind in the saddle.
proficiency.synergy.ferryman.desc: A strong swimmer and a well-armoured mount fear no ford.
proficiency.synergy.heavy_cavalry.desc: A lance couched at the gallop is a charge nothing stops.
proficiency.synergy.horse_whisperer.desc: A horse that trusts you comes when you call.
proficiency.synergy.horse_archer.desc: Steady hands on a moving saddle.
proficiency.synergy.hard_rider.desc: Long days in the saddle toughen a body.
proficiency.synergy.outrider.desc: Ride ahead, spot the field, come back with the news.
proficiency.synergy.cavalry_shield.desc: A shield held high from a high seat.
proficiency.synergy.market_day.desc: A friendly word sells more than a loud one.
proficiency.synergy.fresh_stock.desc: Straight off the line and onto the counter.
proficiency.synergy.book_deal.desc: A scholar knows what a good book is worth.
proficiency.synergy.pantry_account.desc: A cook who is known at every stall.
proficiency.synergy.stone_contract.desc: Good terms for a good wall.
proficiency.synergy.good_furnishings.des: A bargain for every corner of the house.
proficiency.synergy.dig_for_gold.desc: What the shovel finds, the piglin pays for.
proficiency.synergy.fletchers_stall.desc: A grateful village keeps you in arrows.
proficiency.synergy.salon.desc: A fine room fills itself with good company.

proficiency.mastery.swords.desc: Perfect Strike echoes: a phantom second slash lands a moment later on the foe and every hostile beside it for %s damage.
proficiency.mastery.axes.desc: Cleave spins on: every hostile within %s blocks takes 4 damage and is thrown back.
proficiency.mastery.maces.desc: Shockwave heaves the ground: every hostile within %s blocks is thrown into the air.
proficiency.mastery.tridents.desc: Riptide Strike arcs on from the target to %s more hostile(s), 4 damage each.
proficiency.mastery.unarmed.desc: Stunning Blow follows through with %s extra jabs in the same blink, 2 damage each.
proficiency.mastery.blocking.desc: Riposte bashes the attacker away: hurled back about %s blocks and hit for 2.
proficiency.mastery.endurance.desc: Grit washes off the first %s kinds of harmful effect: Slowness, Weakness, Mining Fatigue, Nausea, Blindness, Hunger, Poison, Darkness, Levitation.
proficiency.mastery.archery.desc: Piercing Shot glances on to %s more target(s), 5 damage each, each the nearest hostile to the last.
proficiency.mastery.crossbows.desc: Double Load splinters the bolt: every hostile within %s blocks of the target takes 4 damage.
proficiency.mastery.courage.desc: Rally lets out a cry: every hostile within %s blocks is shoved back and weakened for 6 seconds.
proficiency.mastery.guardian.desc: Intercept sends out a pulse: every hostile within %s blocks is pushed off you.
proficiency.mastery.charger.desc: Breach clears a lane %s blocks long in front of you: hostiles in it take 4 damage and are flung aside.
proficiency.mastery.tactician.desc: Called Shot pins down every hostile within %s blocks: Slowness II and a glow for 5 seconds.
proficiency.mastery.mining.desc: Motherlode makes every ore within %s blocks glow through the rock for 6 seconds (up to 12, nearest first).
proficiency.mastery.woodcutting.desc: Timber plants %s sapling(s) on the bare ground around the stump, of the species that stood there.
proficiency.mastery.excavation.desc: Landslide loosens the ground: the %s nearest blocks of dirt, sand, gravel or clay give way and drop their loot.
proficiency.mastery.farming.desc: Bountiful Harvest bone-meals the %s nearest growing crops around you and replants bare furrows.
proficiency.mastery.fishing.desc: Treasure Haul hooks %s more fish and flings them to you.
proficiency.mastery.husbandry.desc: Twins opens the barn within %s blocks: wool grows back, hens lay an egg, calves grow up faster.
proficiency.mastery.running.desc: Second Wind gives a burst of speed that carries you about %s blocks.
proficiency.mastery.sneaking.desc: Shadowed throws a smoke puff: hunters within %s blocks lose your trail and you vanish for a moment.
proficiency.mastery.jumping.desc: Featherfall springs you about %s blocks into the air, with Slow Falling to bring you down softly.
proficiency.mastery.swimming.desc: Undertow fills your lungs and carries you about %s blocks through the water.
proficiency.mastery.riding.desc: Tailwind mends your mount for %s health and washes harmful effects off it.
proficiency.mastery.smithing.desc: Masterwork tempers your gear: worn armor and the tool in your hand regain %s%% of their durability.
proficiency.mastery.cooking.desc: Second Helping serves seconds: you and everyone within 8 blocks get %s food points and as much saturation.
proficiency.mastery.alchemy.desc: Efficient Draught stretches every helpful effect you have by %s%% of what it has left (5 seconds to 2 minutes).
proficiency.mastery.spellcasting.desc: Arcane Surge looses %s magic missile(s) at separate hostiles within 10 blocks, 3 damage each.
proficiency.mastery.engineering.desc: Overengineered pulls every item lying within %s blocks to your feet.
proficiency.mastery.beastslaying.desc: Trophy Kill feeds you from the kill: %s food points and as much saturation.
proficiency.mastery.wayfaring.desc: New Horizon searches %s chunks for the nearest structure you have not seen and points the way.
proficiency.mastery.spelunking.desc: Cave Sense makes unlooted loot chests and monster spawners within %s blocks glow through the rock.
proficiency.mastery.masonry.desc: Master Mason restores up to %s cracked or mossy stone blocks nearby.
proficiency.mastery.decorating.desc: Inspired opens %s flower(s) on the grass around you.
proficiency.mastery.homebuilder.desc: Hearthglow relights every campfire and candle within %s blocks and leaves you a warm bite.
proficiency.mastery.social.desc: Good Company raises a toast: you and everyone in your company regain %s health.
proficiency.mastery.commerce.desc: Good Deal has a nearby villager throw in %s loaf/loaves of bread.
proficiency.mastery.nightwalker.desc: Moonlit lights up every hostile within %s blocks in silver for 8 seconds.
